package.name: aav_simulator
package.description: Our own simulator, in Rust (rclrs): a drop-in for gz sim and its ros_gz_bridges. It reads Gazebo's own world files, moves the car, casts the roof lidar's and the radar stand-in's rays, and publishes the IMU, GPS, wheels, truth and /clock on the topics the bridges use, so aav_gazebo's nodes and the whole stack run unchanged (sim.launch.py simulator:=own). No cameras yet: they plug in through sim-core's SensorPlugin.
